senses.gloss: उपक m. a diminutive for all proper names of men beginning with उप, Pāṇ. v, 3, 80.
उ॑पाक See उपाञ्च्.
उ॑पाक mf(आ)n. brought near to each other, joined, approximate, (only ए) f. du. (said of night and morning), RV. i, 142, 7; x, 110, 6 (उपा॑के), AV. v, 12, 6; 27, 8
उ॑पाका f. du. (said of night and morning), RV. i, 142, 7; iii, 4, 6; x, 110, 6
उपकादि m. a gaṇa, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 69.
उप-कक्ष॑ mfn. reaching to the shoulder, RV. x, 71, 7; Nir.
being under the arm-pit
उप-कक्ष॑ (अम्), n. (scil. लोमन्) the hair under the arm-pit, GopBr. i, 3, 9.
उप-कक्षदघ्न॑ mfn. reaching up to the shoulder, ŚBr.
उप-कण्ठ mfn. being upon the neck or near the throat
being in the proximity of, proximate, near, Kum.; Pañcat.; Ragh.
उप-कण्ठ n. proximity, neighbourhood, contiguous space, Kathās.; Rājat. &c.
space near a village or its boundary, L.
a horse's gallop, L.
उप-कण्ठम् ind. towards the neck, round the neck, Śiś. iii, 36.
उप-कथा f. a short story, tale
a subordinate narrative.
उप-कनिष्ठिका f. (scil. अङ्गुली) the finger next to the little finger, the last finger but one, ĀśvGṛ.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; HirGṛ. &c.
उप-कन्या = उप-गता कन्याम्, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 194.
उप-कन्या—पुरम् (उप-कन्यापुरम्) ind. near the women's apartments, Daś.
उप-करण &c. See उप- √ 1. कृ.
उप-करण n. the act of doing anything for another, doing a service or favour, helping, assisting, benefiting, Pañcat.; Sāh.; Subh. &c.
instrument, implement, machine, engine, apparatus, paraphernalia (as the vessels at a sacrifice &c.), KātyŚr.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Yājñ.; Mn. &c.
anything added over and above, contribution, expedient
means of subsistence, anything supporting life
any object of art or science
anything fabricated, Mn.; Suśr.; Kathās.; Car. &c.
the insignia of royalty, W.
the attendants of a king, L.
(according to some also) heaping earth (fr. √ कॄ), Viṣṇ.
उपा-करण n. the act of bringing near, fetching, ŚBr.; PārGṛ. &c.
setting about, preparation, beginning, commencing, Āp.; ĀśvŚr. & ĀśvGṛ.; KātyŚr. &c.
commencement of reading the Veda (after the performance of preparatory rites, as initiation &c.), ŚāṅkhGṛ. iv, 5, 1
N. of a particular Stotra or prayer at sacrifices, KātyŚr. iii.
उप-कर्णम् ind. near the ear, close to the ear, Pāṇ.
उपकर्णिका f. that which goes from ear to ear, rumour, report, W.
उप-कर्षण See col. 3.
उप-कर्षण n. the act of drawing or dragging near, Pat.
उप-कलापम् ind. near the girdle, down to the girdle, g. परिमुखादि, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 59 (Kāś.)
उप-कल्प &c. See उप-√ कॢप्.
उप-कल्प m. an appurtenance, BhP.
उप-कान्तम् ind. near a friend, near a lover or a loved one, Kir. i, 19.
उप-कार &c. See उप- √ 1. कृ.
उप-कार m. help, assistance, benefit, service, favour
use, advantage, MBh.; Yājñ.; Hit.; Vikr. &c.
(उपकारे-√ वृत्, to be of service to another, R.)
preparation, ornament, decoration, embellishment (as garlands suspended at gateways on festivals, flowers &c.), Suśr.; L.
उप-काल m. N. of a king of the Nāgas, L.
उप-कालिका f. Nigella Indica, Bhpr.
उप-काश m. aurora, dawn, ĀpŚr.
उप-काश mfn. ifc. aspect, appearance (cf. नीलोपकाश).
उप-काशिनी f. N. of a demon, Hir.
उप-किरण See उप-√ कॄ.
उप-किरण n. the act of scattering or throwing over, covering up (with earth), burying, KātyŚr.
उप-कीचक m. a follower of Kīcaka, MBh.
उप-कुञ्चि f. Nigella Indica, L.
उप-कुञ्चिका f. id., Suśr.
small Cardamoms, L.
उप-कुम्भ mfn. near
उप-कुम्भा f. Croton Polyandrum, Nigh.
उप-कुम्भम् ind. near the water-jar, Kāś.
उप-कुम्भेन ind. near the water-jar, Kāś.
उप-कुम्भे ind. near the water-jar, Kāś.
उप-कुम्भात् ind. from the water-jar
उप-कुरङ्ग m. a species of antelope, Nigh.
उप-कुर्वाण See उप- √ 1. कृ.

उप-कुर्वाण (p. of the Ā. of उप- √ 1. कृ See above) m. a Brahmacārin or student of the Veda who honours his religious teacher by a gift on completing his studies and becoming a Gṛhastha (opposed to the Naiṣṭhika, who stays with his teacher till death), BhP. Comm. on ChUp. &c.
उप-कुल n. ‘secondary family or class’, N. of particular Nakṣatras.
उप-कूल mfn. being or growing on the shore or bank, BhP.; Kād., Kāś. on iv, 3, 59
उप-कुल्या f. Piper Longum, Suśr.
a canal, trench, ditch, L.
उप-कुश m. a gum-boil, Suśr.; Car.
N. of a son of Kuśa, L.
उप-√ कूज्
उप-कूजित mfn. made to resound with cooing, MBh.; BhP.
उप-कूप m. a small well, L.
उप-कूपे ind. near a well, L.
उप-कूप—जलाशय m. a trough near a well for watering cattle.
उप-कूलम् ind. on the shore, Ragh.; BhP.
उप-कूल—तस् ind. on the shore, Ragh.; BhP.
उप-कूलक m. N. of a man.
उप-करण—वत् (उपकरण॑˚) mfn. furnished with means or instruments or implements, competent to do anything, ŚBr.; Car.
उपकरणार्थ mfn. suitable (as a meaning), requisite, Car.
उप-करणी-√ कृ to cause to be instrument, make dependent, Hit.; Hcar.; Kād.
उपकरणी-√ भू to become an instrument, become or be dependent, Kād.
उप-करणीय mfn. to be helped or assisted &c.
उप-कर्तव्य n. (impers.) a service is to be rendered to (gen.), R. (B.)
उप-कर्तृ mf(त्री)n. one who does a favour, one who benefits, a helper, MBh.; Ragh.; Hit.; Sāh.
उप-कारी f. a royal tent
a palace
a caravansery, L.
उप-कार—पर mfn. intent on doing benefits or good, beneficent.
उपकारापकार m. du. kindness and injury.
उप-कारक mf(इका)n. doing a service or favour, assisting, helping, benefiting
suitable, requisite, Hit.; Kathās.; Sarvad. &c.
subsidiary, subservient
accessory, Sarvad.
उप-कारिका f. a protectress, L.
a female assistant, L.
a palace, a caravansery, L.
a kind of cake, L.
उप-कारक—त्व n. the state of being helpful or assisting, Sarvad.
उप-कारिन् mfn. helping, assisting, doing a favour
a benefactor
subsidiary, subservient, requisite, MBh.; Pañcat.; Śak.; Vedāntas. &c.
उपकारि-त्व n. aid, succour, protection, Bhartṛ.
उप-कार्य mfn. to be helped or assisted, deserving or requiring assistance or favour, Sarvad.; Sāh.; KapS.
उप-कार्या f. a royal tent, R.; Ragh.
a king's house, palace
a caravansery
a cemetery, L.
उपकुर्वाणक m. id. Comm. on Mn. ix, 94 Comm. on BhP. &c.
उप-कृत mfn. helped, assisted, benefited
rendered as assistance, done kindly or beneficently &c.
ifc. g. कृतादि, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 59
उप-कृत n. help, favour, benefit, Śak. 165 a; Sāh.
उपा॑-कृत mfn. brought or driven near, fetched, AV. ii, 34, 2
prepared, undertaken, begun
attended with evil omens, disastrous, calamitous, L.

disaster, calamity, L.
उप-कृति f. assistance, help, favour, kindness, Kathās.; Rājat.; Prab.
उपा-कृति f. setting about, beginning, L.
उप-कृति—मत् mfn. one who does a favour, helping, assisting, Śiś.
उपकृतिन् mfn. one who has done or does a favour, a helper &c. g. इष्टादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 88.
उपाकृतिन् mfn. one who prepares or begins g. इष्टादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 88.
उप-क्रिया f. the act of bringing near to
favour, assistance, help, benefit, service, Mn. ii, 149; Rājat.
means, expedient
remedy, Car.

उप-कल्पन n. the act of preparing, preparation, KātyŚr.
उप-कल्पना f. preparing (articles of food or medicine), fabricating, making, Suśr.
substituting, L.
उपकल्पनीय mfn. to be prepared or procured or fetched, Car.
treating of preparation &c. (as & chapter), ib.
उप-कल्पयितव्य mfn. to be prepared or made, Suśr.
उप-कल्पित mfn. prepared, procured, fetched
arranged &c.
उप-कल्पिन् mfn. prepared or ready for (dat.), Baudh.
उप-कल्प्य ind.p. having prepared or procured &c.
उ॑प-कॢप्त mfn. ready, prepared, ŚBr.; AitBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.
equipped, adapted, fitted for, brought near, MBh.; R. &c.

उप-केतु m. N. of a man, Kāṭh.
उ॑प-केरु m. N. of a man, MaitrS.

setting about, undertaking, commencement, beginning, Lāṭy.; KātyŚr.; BhP.; Sāh.; Sarvad. &c.
enterprise, planning, original conception, plan, Ragh.; Rājat.; Pañcat. &c.
anything leading to a result

उप-क्वण or उप-क्वाण m. (√ क्वण्), the sound of a lute, L.

उप-क्षत्र m. N. of a king, VP.

2. उप-क्षय (for 1. See col. 1) m. decrease, decline, decay, waste, Hit. Comm. on VS. &c.

उप-√ क्षर् P. -क्षरति, to flow or stream towards, RV. i, 124, 4; v, 62, 4; AitBr.;
to pour over, TBr.

उपा-कर्म—विधि m. N. of wk.

उपाक्षक m. id.
